name: ownerops-film
description: Cinematic demo production workspace for OwnerOps WebMCP

scripts.render:setup-check: remotion render src/index.ts OwnerOpsFilmSetupCheck renders/setup-check.mp4 --codec h264 --pixel-format yuv420p --overwrite
scripts.render:poc: npm run prepare:film && remotion render src/index.ts OwnerOpsCinematicPoC renders/ownerops-poc.mp4 --codec h264 --pixel-format yuv420p --audio-codec aac --overwrite
scripts.render:poc:sfx-only: npm run prepare:film && remotion render src/index.ts OwnerOpsCinematicPoC renders/ownerops-poc-sfx-only.mp4 --codec h264 --pixel-format yuv420p --audio-codec aac --props=props-sfx-only.json --overwrite
